question: Does the manufacturer-documented 32-bit in-frame counter survive in the released X16 AVI, and if so, can its gaps replace the failed image-similarity bridge with a direct, independently reproducible omission ledger?

inheritedEvidence.L0002: 95,504 nonzero XYPT camera triggers and 95,504 authenticated AVI frames. RC44 decoded only 8 by 8 area averages; those averages cannot preserve four individual boundary pixels.
inheritedEvidence.L0001: 94,736 nonzero XYPT camera triggers and 94,713 AVI frames, a deficit of 23. No L0001 member or pixel has been acquired locally.
inheritedEvidence.RC44Result: The sealed 8 by 8 command-image bridge recovered 105 of 1,232 synthetic deletions within plus or minus one slot with 91.48 percent false-discovery rate, so it did not release L0001.

inspectedBeforeSeal: All committed RC43 and RC44 preregistrations, amendments, acquisition receipts, results, independent audits, and public records.
Manufacturer documentation describing the optional EoSens 3CL 32-bit in-frame counter and NIST publications identifying the X16/X4 camera and trigger semantics.
L0002 archive-level hashes and FFmpeg container metadata: Lagarith, gbrp, 120 by 120, 95,504 frames. No RC45 full-resolution pixel or corner sample was decoded.
notInspectedBeforeSeal: Any native-resolution L0002 pixel value, corner-byte series, inferred counter value, or counter-step statistic.
Any L0001 compressed member byte, decoded pixel, inferred counter value, or missing position.
fixedCausalChain: Public X16 AVI plus documented EoSens counter capability
optional counter may be disabled, transformed, cropped, or spatially reoriented by export
a fixed four-pixel boundary series follows an exact 32-bit modulo increment
independent Python and JavaScript decoders reproduce the same values and step ledger
counter gaps delimit missing camera identities; absolute XYPT slots require endpoint anchoring

decoder.name: FFmpeg 7.1 Windows x86-64 binary already hash-bound in RC44
decoder.nativeOutput: gbrp; preserve all three 8-bit planes; do not convert to calibrated radiance or temperature

fixedDevelopmentProcedure.valueCandidates: For each boundary and each native G, B, and R plane, interpret the four left-to-right bytes as both little-endian and big-endian unsigned 32-bit integers. This yields 24 prespecified series. No pixel permutation, offset, crop, arithmetic transform, or learned rule may be added after decoding.
metrics: frame count and raw 48-byte-per-frame boundary-record SHA-256
number and fraction of modulo-2^32 consecutive differences equal to 1
number of zero, reverse-or-wrap-inconsistent, and greater-than-one differences
maximum forward difference, number of unique values, and total missing count sum(diff minus 1) for forward differences

counterPositive: At least one prespecified series has exactly 95,503 of 95,503 modulo differences equal to 1.
That series has 95,504 unique values and modulo span exactly 95,503.
Python and JavaScript agree exactly on boundary, byte order, per-frame values, every aggregate, and raw boundary-record SHA-256.

Additional passing color planes are permitted only when their complete value series is byte-for-byte identical; a decoder orientation alias is reported rather than counted as independent confirmation.
developmentGate.counterNegative: If no prespecified series passes all positive conditions, do not acquire L0001. Preserve the best step fraction only as evidence about a possible transformed or disabled marker, not as an identifier.
developmentGate.stopOnDecoderDisagreement: If the two implementations disagree on any extracted byte or metric, do not acquire L0001.

fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.release: Acquire the exact L0001 XYPT and AVI ZIP-member ranges only after a committed development release states that every development-gate condition passed.
fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.sameRule: Apply only the L0002-passing boundary, plane-equivalence class, and byte order. No alternative candidate may be tried on L0001.
fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.internalGapRule: For consecutive decoded values c_j and c_(j+1), delta_j=(c_(j+1)-c_j) mod 2^32. A delta greater than 1 contributes delta minus 1 missing counter identities between the two observed frames.
validity: Every delta must be between 1 and 24 inclusive.
The sum of delta minus 1 must not exceed the known aggregate deficit 23.
Python and JavaScript must agree exactly on every counter value, delta, gap value, and counter-relative missing position.
fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.endpointEnvelope: Let r be 23 minus the number of internal missing counter identities. Enumerate every k from 0 through r as a possible number of missing triggers before the first preserved frame; the remaining r minus k lie after the last. Shift every internal counter-relative gap by k. Report the intersection across k as required absolute slots and the union as possible absolute slots. Do not select k from image similarity.
fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.success: A nonempty required set or a possible set materially smaller than all 94,736 slots is a positional advance. Exact absolute identities require r=0 or an independent endpoint anchor.
fixedNaturalHoldoutProcedure.failure: If values are not a valid progression, gaps exceed 23, or implementations disagree, retain only the aggregate deficit and mark transfer from L0002 as rejected.

competingHypotheses.claim: The in-frame counter is absent or not recoverable from the released AVI.
competingHypotheses.prediction: No prespecified L0002 series is an exact unit-step progression.
competingHypotheses.adjudication: Stop before L0001 and return to full-image spatiotemporal signatures or the unreleased raw acquisition record.

competingHypotheses.claim: A lossless direct frame counter is preserved and L0002 is internally complete.
competingHypotheses.prediction: One boundary/order equivalence class advances by exactly one through all 95,504 frames.
competingHypotheses.adjudication: Release the same frozen parser on L0001.

competingHypotheses.claim: All 23 L0001 omissions occur between preserved frames.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Counter gaps contain exactly 23 missing identities, leaving endpoint residual r equal to zero.
competingHypotheses.adjudication: Report the 23 absolute trigger slots conditional only on the documented trigger-to-frame semantics and independently verify the ledger.

competingHypotheses.claim: At least one omission is outside the preserved counter interval.
competingHypotheses.prediction: Internal gaps sum to fewer than 23, leaving r greater than zero.
competingHypotheses.adjudication: Report required and possible sets across every leading/trailing allocation; do not force a tail-only answer.

competingHypotheses.claim: Counter transfer is invalid because reset, reordering, duplication, or export transformation occurred.
competingHypotheses.prediction: L0001 contains zero, backward, greater-than-24, or deficit-inconsistent steps under the frozen parser.
competingHypotheses.adjudication: Reject positional interpretation and preserve the failure as a counterexample.

implementations: Python standard-library stream parser that invokes the hash-bound FFmpeg binary
JavaScript standard-library stream parser that invokes the same hash-bound FFmpeg binary without importing Python output
independence.sharedDependency: The codec implementation is shared and therefore decoder diversity is absent. Byte-for-byte implementation agreement detects parser and arithmetic errors but not a common FFmpeg decoding error.
independence.holdoutSeparation: Only the sealed development verdict file may release L0001. The natural parser consumes the frozen winning candidate and cannot search alternatives.

resourceBudget.L0002: Use the already authenticated local AVI; boundary extraction writes at most 4.6 MiB per implementation.
resourceBudget.prohibited: Do not download a full multi-gigabyte archive, TIFF archive, or any other layer. Do not acquire L0001 if the exact L0002 gate fails.

uncertaintyBudget.measurement: Lagarith and FFmpeg are lossless at the decoded stream level, but earlier camera-to-recorder and recorder-to-AVI transformations may crop, reorder, or replace pixels.
uncertaintyBudget.model: Counter interpretation assumes the documented firmware feature and modulo increment rule; spatial location and byte order are exhaustively limited to 24 prespecified candidates.
uncertaintyBudget.sampling: One equal-count layer qualifies transfer to one adjacent deficit layer; behavior across the remaining 248 layers is not estimated.
uncertaintyBudget.implementation: Two parsers share one decoder and the same released bytes, so common-mode codec error remains.
uncertaintyBudget.extrapolation: An internal gap proves a missing camera counter identity between preserved frames, not the physical cause, defect state, or whether a commanded trigger reached every acquisition component.
uncertaintyBudget.endpoint: Without an external start/end anchor, residual omissions can shift internal gaps within a finite envelope.

minimumAdvance: Demonstrating or decisively rejecting a direct counter in 95,504 released frames separates acquisition identity from the failed morphology bridge. If present, even a partial L0001 internal-gap ledger sharply narrows the omission space.
safetyEthicsEnvironment: Only public NIST process data are read. No machine is actuated, no personal data are processed, and no manufacturing safety or defect certification is inferred. Exact member ranges and four-pixel extraction bound transfer and compute costs.
